title: Engineer ops deep-dive 1:1 — Lina
content:
Goal: quick sync to unblock the Dedicated rollout pilot and get alignment on private deployment onboarding and Console telemetry fixes. Keep to 30 mins; leave parking-lot items for async follow-up.

Context notes (for Ravi):
- Dedicated pilot with Wave 1 customers starts mid-Mar (internal target). We need to confirm autoscale policy defaults + surge plan.
- Private on-prem checklist still missing 2 items: KMS flow for air-gapped installs, and network egress testing harness (QA flagged flaky).
- Console telemetry: token cost breakdown is off for batching-heavy requests — UX shows inflated per-request token counts (possible attribution bug after batching change in runtime).

Agenda (30m)
1) 5m — Quick status: Dedicated pilot readiness (capacity, SLA gating items)
2) 8m — Private onboarding blockers (KMS, egress test), owners and timeline
3) 8m — Console telemetry discrepancy: suspected root causes and short-term mitigation (hotfix vs config change)
4) 4m — Risks, escalations, immediate asks (budget/infra/SE help)
5) 5m — Action list + confirm owners + draft sync note to stakeholders

Key prep bullets for me (Lina):
- Bring the Wave 1 customer list (2 customers wanting on-prem): AcmeHealth and FinStone. Confirmed their legal I/Os but not infra dates.
- Ask Ravi for a 1-line on autoscale default policy (min replicas, warm pool size).
- Ask about failover for dedicated pools crossing regions (policy for cross-region fallback to hosted) — cost/latency tradeoffs.
- Ask whether batching attribution change in runtime could map tokens to request start instead of origin shard (this would explain double-counting).

Discussion prompts (phrasing)
- "Ravi — for Dedicated autoscale, if a pool hits sustained 80% GPU util for 3mins, what do we do next? Warm a node or spin new instance? Which path is cheaper at scale?"
- "On Private KMS: do we need a staged implementation (lite: wrapped keys + cloud-KMS; full: customer HSM)? Which is realistic for Wave 1?"
- "Telemetry: if we can't ship a fix before pilot, can we add an attribution disclaimer + reduce visibility in billing UI?"

Open questions to capture live
- Can we compress the egress test suite so on-prem validation is single-day? Who owns that automation?
- Do we have an SLO for Console billing UI accuracy? If not, should set one for Q2.

Immediate blockers (from product side)
- Infra quota for Dedicated warm pool (billing approval pending) — need finance ok to reserve additional GPUs.
- QA says private-install VM image sometimes fails checksum step (INF-7892). Need a retriable installer step.

Proposed quick wins (to propose to Ravi)
- Short-term: add a per-route token-estimate disclaimer in Console + flag routes with batching-heavy traffic so CS doesn't rely on raw numbers.
- Mid-term: add attribution tag in runtime (route_id + batch_origin) so we can reconcile after next release.
- Private onboarding: ship "lite KMS" path for Wave 1 customers with documented migration to HSM later.

Draft action items (fill in owner + ETA in meeting)
- Action: Add batching attribution tag in runtime logging. Owner: (Ravi?) ETA: 2 sprints.
- Action: Small hotfix to Console UI to hide per-request token if route flagged as aggregated. Owner: (Emma?) ETA: 1 week.
- Action: QA to add a retry + checksum diagnostic to installer. Owner: QA lead (TBD) linked JIRA: JIRA-INF-7892. ETA: 5 days.
- Action: Product to draft Wave 1 public-facing note about pilot scope and known telemetry caveats. Owner: Lina. ETA: 3 days.

Notes to self (Lina)
- Bring customer impact examples (screenshots) for Console token issue — makes it concrete.
- If Ravi pushes back on lite KMS, ask for partial plan that covers at least logging/telemetry PII rules.
- Keep language around SLAs careful: avoid promising cross-region fallback latency numbers.

Parking lot (async follow-ups)
- Deep-dive on autoscale cost model (run cost vs. latency) — schedule 60m next week with infra finance.
- Private deployment runbook: move from doc draft to checklist + automated gating (Confluence -> runbook repo).

Quick stakeholder note (post-meeting skeleton)
- Subject: Dedicated pilot status and Console telemetry caveat (short)
- Body bullets: What we decided (autoscale defaults confirmed / need finance for warm pool); what we will fix (hotfix to hide batching-attributed token counts; runtime tagging to reconcile); Wave 1 customer impact and timeline.

Prep checklist (before meeting)
- [ ] Attach 2 example Console screenshots
- [ ] Open INF-7892 in meeting and have QA rep on thread
- [ ] Copy the Dedicated capacity numbers (current reserved vs needed)
- [ ] Confirm Ravi availability next Thurs for autoscale cost-model deep-dive

End of doc — will fill in owners/ETAs during 1:1 and move to final status when emailed to stakeholders.

-- Lina
